voice.name: Open Sector - Wraith
voice.description: Young reconnaissance drone operator in his late twenties speaking with a light, clipped accent over a crackly aircraft intercom, cool, precise and quietly proud, soft mid voice, very sure of his strange tailless aircraft, calm and observant, sounds like he is high above the war watching it through a camera.
voice.sample: Wraith, at altitude. Nothing up here can catch us. Below, three columns on the road to the river. Cameras running. I count them, I photograph them, and I am gone before their guns even look up.

ready: Wraith fueled and ready. Cameras loaded.

move.prompt: Flying-wing reconnaissance drone taking off, two small buried jet engines whining and rising in pitch as it accelerates down a grass runway and climbs away, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Jet drone shot down, engines sputtering and flaming out, whistling descent and crash with explosion and tearing metal, outdoors, no music, no voice
